evidence.text: Home - El Calamar Restaurant Skip to content Home About Us Contact Menu Order Online Reservations Order Now Order Now Reservations Home About Us Contact Menu Order Online Reservations Order Now Order Now Dive into flavor Authentic Mexican Seafood El Mejor Sabor del Mar Since 2007 Welcome Authentic Mexican Grill & Seafood in Santa Ana Welcome to El Calamar on 17th Street. We serve up fresh Mexican seafood and grilled favorites every single day. Whether you are here for our famous Molcajetes or just a cold michelada, you are part of the family. Come see why we are a local favorite for authentic flavor and great vibes. More About Us Hours Monday - Closed Tuesday - Friday | 11AM - 10PM Saturday 10AM - 12AM Sunday 10AM - 10PM Our Menu Bold Spices and Traditional Recipes Every dish is prepared with our house-made salsas and authentic Mexican spices. Experience the perfect balance of heat, citrus, and the freshest catch available today. Choriqueso Cheese fondue topped with chorizo. $24 Camarones Aguachile Shrimp cooked in lime, with cilantro salsa, toped with red onions, and cilantro $30 Molcajete Mixto Chicken, steak, and shrimp $39 Mojarra Deep fry tilapia​ $19 Fajitas CIELO MAR TIERRA chicken, steak, & Shrimp add Octopus +$5.00 $29 Discover Entire Menu Karaoke Fridays Fridays/Viernes Noche de Karaoke Food and Drink Specials Kick off the weekend with Santa Ana’s favorite Friday night tradition. Join us every Friday starting at 7:00 PM for Karaoke Night, where the energy is high and the mic is always open. We keep the party going all night with exclusive food and drink specials that you won’t want to miss. Bring your friends, grab a cold drink, and experience the best Friday night vibe in town. Find Us Here Happy Customers! It fits your budget very well and for me it's my favorite restaurant; you won't find their sauces and the seasoning of their dishes anywhere else. - Catalina Flores Very good variety of dishes, the 7 Seas is highly recommended, very well served and full of seafood. - Gustavo Villanueva Absolutely amazing food! Seriously the best in the area and such a great price! The food is authentic and the drinks are strong. The service is always amazing! The wait staff checked on us multiple times always attending to us with a great smile and attitude. I would recommend this place to anyone and everyone! I’m going to be dreaming of this food for days! Look forward to coming back!!!! - Candice Viergutz Check Out Our Reviews Yelp Facebook-f Google-plus-g Book your reservation online or give us a call.
